metadata.description: Primary standards, implementation guides, and tooling references for accessibility engineering.
metadata.title: Software Accessibility - Sources

standards.name: WCAG 2.2
standards.description: W3C WCAG 2.2 Recommendation; check the jurisdiction or contract before choosing a binding baseline.

standards.name: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
standards.description: Canonical widget patterns, keyboard behavior, and ARIA guidance.

standards.name: EN 301 549
standards.description: European accessibility requirements for ICT procurement and compliance.

standards.name: Section 508
standards.description: US federal accessibility requirements and implementation guidance.

standards.name: European Accessibility Act
standards.description: Official EAA legal text for digital accessibility obligations in the EU market.
standards.verification_status: unverified: official text returned a bot challenge on 2026-09-28; verify article and national duties before relying on them

standards.name: European Commission EAA Notice
standards.description: European Commission guidance on EAA application timing and business obligations.

standards.name: Federal Register — DOJ ADA Title II Web/Mobile Compliance-Date Extension
standards.description: DOJ Interim Final Rule, effective 20 April 2026, extending ADA Title II web/mobile-app compliance dates by one year (population 50,000+: 26 Apr 2027; under 50,000 or special districts: 26 Apr 2028). Technical standard remains WCAG 2.1 AA. Verify comment-period outcome before citing as final.

standards.name: W3C WCAG 3 Introduction
standards.description: Current status of the WCAG 3.0 Working Draft; use to verify draft date, outcome count, and conformance-tier model before citing 3.0 details.

implementation_and_tooling.name: axe-core
implementation_and_tooling.description: Widely used automation library for accessibility rule checks.

implementation_and_tooling.name: Playwright Accessibility Testing
implementation_and_tooling.description: Playwright guidance for accessibility assertions in E2E tests.

implementation_and_tooling.name: The A11Y Project
implementation_and_tooling.description: Practical accessibility checklists and implementation articles.

implementation_and_tooling.name: WebAIM
implementation_and_tooling.description: Accessibility implementation resources, tools, and testing guidance.

implementation_and_tooling.name: FTC Decision and Order — accessiBe
implementation_and_tooling.description: Consent order issued 21 April 2025, publicly announced 22 April; requires a $1,000,000 payment and bars unsupported automatic WCAG-compliance claims. Does not prove overlay litigation causation.

implementation_and_tooling.name: Pa11y runner and standard configuration
implementation_and_tooling.description: HTML_CodeSniffer is the default runner; WCAG2AA is its profile, not full WCAG 2.2 coverage.

implementation_and_tooling.name: Next.js route announcer
implementation_and_tooling.description: Built-in announcer uses document.title, then h1, then pathname.

implementation_and_tooling.name: HTML dialog
implementation_and_tooling.description: showModal provides modality and document inertness; test naming and focus behavior.

implementation_and_tooling.name: HTML Popover API
implementation_and_tooling.description: Non-modal transient-surface behavior; choose widget semantics separately.

implementation_and_tooling.name: CSS forced colors
implementation_and_tooling.description: Forced colors can remove box shadows; use system colors and test focus indicators.

implementation_and_tooling.name: Radix accessibility
implementation_and_tooling.description: APG-aligned primitive behavior; verify the composed widget.

implementation_and_tooling.name: W3C ISO/IEC 40500 mapping
implementation_and_tooling.description: ISO/IEC 40500:2025 maps to October 2023 WCAG 2.2; verify the requested edition.

implementation_and_tooling.name: W3C status messages
implementation_and_tooling.description: Short task-status feedback; avoid chatty whole-section live regions.

implementation_and_tooling.name: W3C non-text contrast
implementation_and_tooling.description: Author focus indicator contrast and unmodified user-agent exception.

implementation_and_tooling.name: axe React diagnostics
implementation_and_tooling.description: Development-console diagnostics on component updates; not a component-test runner.
